title: RocketAgent: A Long-Horizon Engineering Agent for Multidisciplinary Design of Liquid-Rocket Thrust Chambers
abstract: arXiv:2610.06044v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Liquid-rocket thrust-chamber design involves interdependent analyses in which downstream constraints can require earlier design decisions to be revisited. Managing these dependencies across heterogeneous tools requires consistent design information and coordinated updates throughout the workflow. We present RocketAgent, a long-horizon engineering agent for multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers. A single plan-owning Coding Agent coordinates engineering skills for performance sizing, subsystem optimization, geometry generation, and multiphysics assessment. A provenance-aware knowledge graph supports method selection, while a typed Design Intermediate Representation maintains shared parameters, artifacts, and decisions. translated_title: RocketAgent：面向液体火箭推力室多学科设计的长周期工程智能体
translated_abstract: 液体火箭推力室设计涉及相互依赖的分析过程，其中下游约束可能要求重新审视早期的设计决策。在异构工具之间管理这些依赖关系，需要一致的设计信息以及贯穿整个工作流程的协调更新。我们提出了RocketAgent，一个用于液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计的长周期工程智能体。由单一的“计划持有型”编码智能体协调性能尺寸计算、子系统优化、几何生成和多物理场评估等工程技能。来源感知知识图谱支持方法选择，类型化的设计中间表示维护共享参数、产物与决策。具备修订感知的检查机制使受影响的结果失效并阻止已被取代的输入，而对连锁性变更则须经工程审批。在一个具有代表性的基于仿真的设计中……
tldr: RocketAgent提出了一个由编码智能体统一规划、依托来源感知知识图谱与类型化设计中间表示的长周期工程智能体框架，实现了液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计中跨异构工具依赖关系的一致管理与协调更新。
en_tdlr: RocketAgent presents a long-horizon engineering agent framework in which a plan-owning coding agent, supported by a provenance-aware knowledge graph and a typed design intermediate representation, enables consistent design information management and coordinated updates across heterogeneous tools in the multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers.
